To calculate the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) for FY2019, we first need to compute Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO), Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), and Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) based on the provided financial statements for FY2018 and FY2019.

### **1. Data Extraction (from Balance Sheets, Income Statement, and Notes):**
* **FY2019 Revenue (Net sales):** $16,865.2 million
* **FY2019 Cost of Sales (COGS):** $11,108.4 million

* **Inventories:**
  * FY2018 (May 27, 2018): $1,642.2 million
  * FY2019 (May 26, 2019): $1,559.3 million
  * *Average Inventory:* $(1,642.2 + 1,559.3) / 2 = $1,600.75$ million
  * *Change in Inventory (FY2019 - FY2018):* $1,559.3 - 1,642.2 = -82.9$ million

* **Accounts Receivable (Receivables - Customers):**
  * FY2018 (May 27, 2018): $1,712.6 million *(Note 17)*
  * FY2019 (May 26, 2019): $1,708.5 million *(Note 17)*
  * *Average Accounts Receivable:* $(1,712.6 + 1,708.5) / 2 = $1,710.55$ million

* **Accounts Payable:**
  * FY2018 (May 27, 2018): $2,746.2 million
  * FY2019 (May 26, 2019): $2,854.1 million
  * *Average Accounts Payable:* $(2,746.2 + 2,854.1) / 2 = $2,800.15$ million

---

### **2. Component Calculations:**

* **DIO (Days Inventory Outstanding):**
  $$\text{DIO} = \frac{365 \times \text{Average Inventory}}{\text{FY2019 COGS}} = \frac{365 \times 1,600.75}{11,108.4} \approx 52.59 \text{ days}$$

* **DSO (Days Sales Outstanding):**
  $$\text{DSO} = \frac{365 \times \text{Average Accounts Receivable}}{\text{FY2019 Revenue}} = \frac{365 \times 1,710.55}{16,865.2} \approx 37.03 \text{ days}$$

* **DPO (Days Payable Outstanding):**
  $$\text{DPO} = \frac{365 \times \text{Average Accounts Payable}}{\text{FY2019 COGS} + \text{Change in Inventory}} = \frac{365 \times 2,800.15}{11,108.4 + (-82.9)} = \frac{1,022,054.75}{11,025.5} \approx 92.70 \text{ days}$$

---

### **3. Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC):**
$$\text{CCC} = \text{DIO} + \text{DSO} - \text{DPO}$$
$$\text{CCC} = 52.59 + 37.03 - 92.70 = -3.08 \text{ days}$$

**Answer:**
The FY2019 Cash Conversion Cycle for General Mills is **-3.08** days.
